meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上 FlowIO 技能后，Claude 能读取流式细胞术的 FCS 标准文件，解析文件里的元数据和通道信息，把事件数据提取成 NumPy 数组，还能创建新的 FCS 文件、把数据转成表格格式。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取或解析 FCS 文件、提取事件数据、查看通道信息等时触发。

say.text: 读取这个FCS文件，列出所有通道名称和事件数量。
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并显示通道和事件数。

say.text: 把这份FCS数据导出成CSV文件。
say.note: 将事件数据转成表格保存。

say.text: 按第一通道大于500筛选事件，另存为新FCS。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can read Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) files (v2.0-3.1), parse metadata and channel info, extract event data as NumPy arrays, create new FCS files, and export data to table formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to read or parse FCS files, extract event data, or inspect channel info.

say_en.text: Read this FCS file and list all channel names and event count.
say_en.note: Parses the file and shows channels and events.

say_en.text: Export this FCS data to a CSV file.
say_en.note: Saves event data as a table.

say_en.text: Filter events where the first channel > 500 and save as a new FCS.
